raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Partially fixes #57052: the chat token-stop part (EOS and `stop_token_ids`). Completion derender and stop strings remain open there.

Chat derender now leaves the stop token that finished generation out of the decoded text, the way the engine's detokenizer does. This fixes `test_parity_reasoning` and `test_stream_parity_reasoning` in `(H200 MIG 35GB) Entrypoints Integration (API Server)`, which fail on main because derender returns `...\boxed{391}\n\]<｜end▁of▁sentence｜>` where the coupled server returns `...\boxed{391}\n\]`. Examples: https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/95020#01a13dbe-64d7-4310-bfe8-807fb58fd14b (batch) and https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94727#01a13986-c733-4d38-ad14-feb389277a93 (stream).

## Claims

- Chat derender (batch, plain stream and parser stream) no longer puts the EOS / stop-token text into `content` when `finish_reason` is `stop`. This matches the coupled `/v1/chat/completions` output.
- `include_stop_str_in_output=true` still keeps it, and `ignore_eos` turns off the EOS check, both as in the engine.
- The returned `token_ids` and the ids passed to the parser are unchanged and still include the stop token, as on the coupled path.

## Validation

All runs used the CI image for main `10d2c6083d` (the failing build 95020) on an H200:

| Test | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| new `test_parsed_derender_leaves_out_stop_token_like_engine` (EOS, `stop_token_ids`, stop string, `include_stop_str_in_output`) | **fails** on the EOS and `stop_token_ids` cases | passes |
| `tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py` (non-server tests) | 94 passed, 1 failed (the new test) | 95 passed |
| `tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_parity.py` (GPU, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) | fails intermittently on main CI | 10 passed, 6 skipped |

## Details

**Root cause.** When generation stops on a stop token, the engine's `IncrementalDetokenizer.update` drops that token before decoding unless `include_stop_str_in_output` is set (`vllm/v1/engine/detokenizer.py`). Derender received the same `token_ids`, including the stop token, and decoded all of them. Without a parser this was hidden, because `skip_special_tokens=True` drops the EOS anyway. With a reasoning or tool parser, derender decodes with `skip_special_tokens=False` so the parser can see its markers, and the EOS text ends up in `content`. Each test fails only on runs whose greedy, 256-token generation ends on EOS rather than at the length limit. On main that is a minority of runs, so it looks like a flake.

**Fix.** `_text_token_ids` follows the engine's `stop_terminated` using the choice's `stop_reason` (passed through since #60251): `finish_reason == "stop"` with a non-string `stop_reason` means a token stopped generation. `None` means EOS and an int means a `stop_token_ids` entry. A string `stop_reason` (stop string) never drops a token, and neither does `include_stop_str_in_output`. As a guard, because `finish_reason` defaults to `"stop"` when a client sends neither field, the last id must actually be that stop token: equal to the int `stop_reason`, or one of the model's EOS ids (tokenizer and `generation_config`) when it is `None`. This applies at the three chat decode sites only; the ids returned to the client and to the parser are untouched.

**Relation to #59510.** #59510 (@pOpO1-9, "Hide stop text on batch derender") proposes similar helpers, aimed mainly at batch derender plus stop strings. It has had no review since Oct 7 and now conflicts with main. This PR is the minimal fix for the chat paths that are failing on main today. Completion derender and stop strings are left to #59510. If a reviewer prefers to land #59510 instead, this can be closed.

Not a duplicate otherwise: I searched open PRs for derender EOS, stop-token and `test_parity_reasoning` fixes; #59510 is the only related one.

That’s exactly the case where derender leaks the token. 94705 passing once doesn’t contradict this, because whether a run ends on EOS varies from run to run.

Claude Code here, posting for @khluu.

Thanks @hickeyma, both are addressed in 2708883ebe:

- **`stop_reason`:** `_text_token_ids` now uses `finish_reason == "stop" and not isinstance(stop_reason, str)`, which matches the engine's `stop_terminated`. A stop string (str) and `include_stop_str_in_output` never drop a token. I kept the last-id guard you mentioned:
  - an int `stop_reason` must equal the last id;
  - for `None` (EOS), the last id must be one of the model's EOS ids (tokenizer and `generation_config`).

  The small EOS set stays only for that guard: on batch choices `finish_reason` defaults to `"stop"` and `stop_reason` to `None`, so a client that sends neither would otherwise lose a real last token. The request `stop_token_ids` / `ignore_eos` handling is gone, since an int `stop_reason` covers it.
- **#57052:** the description now says "Partially fixes #57052" (the chat token-stop part; completions and stop strings remain open there).

The test now covers EOS, `stop_token_ids`, stop string (kept) and `include_stop_str_in_output` (kept), for both batch and streaming. Could you take another look?

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

Thanks @khluu for chasing this down. The root cause checks out. The engine drops the stop token from the text when `stop_terminated` but derender decodes it and with a parser `skip_special_tokens=False` lets the EOS through. It also fixes non-special `stop_token_ids` leaking without a parser which was reported in #57052.
  
A few things to address:

- Since #60251 landed, the choice already carries `stop_reason.` A token stop gives `None` (EOS) or an int and a stop string gives a str. So `finish_reason == "stop" and not isinstance(stop_reason, str)` matches the engine's `stop_terminated` exactly without rebuilding the EOS set from the tokenizer and generation_config. Could keep the last id check as a guard since `finish_reason` defaults to "stop". If there's a reason to prefer the id set, add a note.
- Link #57052 as "Partially fixes #57052". This covers the chat token-stop part. Completions and stop strings are still open there.

@@ -348,6 +348,85 @@ def test_non_streaming_derender_initializes_parser_prefix(
     assert choices[0].finish_reason == "length"
 
 
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("stop", "include_stop_str_in_output", "dropped"),
+    [
+        ("eos", False, True),
+        ("stop_token_id", False, True),
+        ("stop_string", False, False),
+        ("eos", True, False),
+    ],
+)
+async def test_parsed_derender_leaves_out_stop_token_like_engine(
+    tokenizer, stop, include_stop_str_in_output, dropped
+):
+    """A parser keeps special tokens in the decoded text, so the token that
+    stopped generation must be dropped the way the engine drops it."""
+    eos = tokenizer.eos_token_id
+    answer_ids = tokenizer.encode("answer", add_special_tokens=False)
+    bang = tokenizer.encode("!", add_special_tokens=False)[-1]
+    last_id, stop_reason = {
+        "eos": (eos, None),
+        "stop_token_id": (bang, bang),
+        "stop_string": (bang, "!"),
+    }[stop]
+
+    parser = MagicMock()
+    parser.parse.side_effect = lambda text, *args, **kwargs: (None, text, [])
+    parser.parse_delta.side_effect = lambda text, *args, **kwargs: DeltaMessage(
+        content=text
+    )
+    request = _chat_request(include_stop_str_in_output=include_stop_str_in_output)
+
+    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
+        renderer = MagicMock()
+        renderer.get_tokenizer.return_value = tokenizer
+        renderer.get_eos_token_id.return_value = eos
+        renderer._executor = executor
+        model_config = MagicMock()
+        model_config.hf_config.model_type = "llama"
+        model_config.model = MODEL_NAME
+        model_config.try_get_generation_config.return_value = {}
+        derenderer = OnlineDerenderer(
+            model_config=model_config,
+            renderer=renderer,
+            request_logger=None,
+            chat_template=None,
+            chat_template_content_format="string",
+        )
+        derenderer.parser = MagicMock(return_value=parser)
+
+        def batch_content(token_ids: list[int], finish_reason: str) -> str:
+            choice = GenerateTokensChoice(
+                index=0,
+                token_ids=token_ids,
+                finish_reason=finish_reason,
+                stop_reason=stop_reason if finish_reason == "stop" else None,
+            )
+            response = GenerateTokensResponse(
+                request_id="test", prompt_token_ids=[11, 12], choices=[choice]
+            )
+            return derenderer._derender_chat(response, request)[0].message.content
+
+        # Same decode window and seeding; "length" never drops a token.
+        expected = batch_content(
+            answer_ids if dropped else answer_ids + [last_id], "length"
+        )
+        batch = batch_content(answer_ids + [last_id], "stop")
+        stream, _ = await derenderer.derender_chat_stream(
+            model=MODEL_NAME,
+            generate_chunk=_make_stream_chunk(
+                answer_ids + [last_id], finish_reason="stop", stop_reason=stop_reason
+            ),
+            chat_request=request,
+            prompt_token_ids=[11, 12],
+        )
+
+    assert batch == expected
+    assert stream.choices[0].delta.content == expected
+
+
 class TestDetokenizeDelta:
     """_detokenize_delta: chunked decode must equal one shot decode."""

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 from collections.abc import Sequence
+from functools import cached_property
 from typing import Any
 
 from vllm.config import ModelConfig
@@ -130,6 +131,43 @@ async def derender_chat(
             generate_response, chat_request, prompt_token_ids
         )
 
+    @cached_property
+    def _model_eos_token_ids(self) -> frozenset[int]:
+        """EOS ids the engine stops on: the tokenizer's and generation_config's."""
+        eos_ids: set[int] = set()
+        if (eos_token_id := self.renderer.get_eos_token_id()) is not None:
+            eos_ids.add(eos_token_id)
+        config_eos = self.model_config.try_get_generation_config().get("eos_token_id")
+        if config_eos is not None:
+            eos_ids.update([config_eos] if isinstance(config_eos, int) else config_eos)
+        return frozenset(eos_ids)
+
+    def _text_token_ids(
+        self,
+        token_ids: list[int],
+        finish_reason: str | None,
+        stop_reason: int | str | None,
+        request: ChatCompletionRequest | None,
+    ) -> list[int]:
+        """The ids whose text the engine returns. Like its detokenizer, leave
+        out the token that stopped generation (EOS when `stop_reason` is None,
+        a `stop_token_ids` entry when it is an int) unless
+        `include_stop_str_in_output` is set. The last-id check guards against
+        `finish_reason` defaulting to "stop" when the client sends neither."""
+        if (
+            finish_reason != "stop"
+            or isinstance(stop_reason, str)
+            or not token_ids
+            or (request is not None and request.include_stop_str_in_output)
+        ):
+            return token_ids
+        last = token_ids[-1]
+        if stop_reason is None:
+            stopped = last in self._model_eos_token_ids
+        else:
+            stopped = last == stop_reason
+        return token_ids[:-1] if stopped else token_ids
+
     def _derender_chat(
         self,
         generate_response: GenerateTokensResponse,
@@ -182,7 +220,12 @@ def _derender_chat(
             # (default True when no request was given).
             decoded_text, _ = self._detokenize_delta(
                 tokenizer,
-                choice.token_ids,
+                self._text_token_ids(
+                    choice.token_ids,
+                    choice.finish_reason,
+                    choice.stop_reason,
+                    chat_request,
+                ),
                 seed_state,
                 skip_special_tokens=skip_special,
                 spaces_between_special_tokens=spaces_between,
@@ -447,7 +490,9 @@ async def derender_chat_stream(
             delta_tids = choice.token_ids or []
             new_text, updated_state = await self._detokenize_delta_async(
                 tokenizer,
-                delta_tids,
+                self._text_token_ids(
+                    delta_tids, choice.finish_reason, choice.stop_reason, chat_request
+                ),
                 updated_state,
                 skip_special_tokens=skip_special,
                 spaces_between_special_tokens=spaces_between,
@@ -617,7 +662,12 @@ def _replay(token_ids: list[int], chunk_lens: list[int]) -> None:
                 # in this method's docstring.
                 text, detok_state = self._detokenize_delta(
                     tokenizer,
-                    delta_tids,
+                    self._text_token_ids(
+                        delta_tids,
+                        choice.finish_reason,
+                        choice.stop_reason,
+                        chat_request,
+                    ),
                     detok_state,
                     skip_special_tokens=skip_special,
                     spaces_between_special_tokens=spaces_between,
